Gênero, geração e cultura não representam barreiras no que diz respeito ao conhecimento, talentos e habilidades. title: Brazil - Rio de Janeiro: Tax Manager
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Job Duties Lead all tax-related activities in Brazil, including direct and indirect taxes, transfer pricing, and tax reporting required by internal corporate team. Ensure full compliance with federal, state and municipal tax regulations. Develop and implement tax planning strategies to optimize the company’s tax position and mitigate tax risks. Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors, tax consultants, and government authorities. Provide expert tax guidance on contracts, new business initiatives, cross-border transactions supporting domestic activities and business operations to ensure compliance, tax optimization and appropriate risk management. Monitor and assess the impact of changes in tax legislation & Brazil Tax Reform on business operations. Oversee timely and accurate preparation and submission of tax filings and audits. Oversee local audits, improve tax policies and process. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Accounting, Taxation or Tax Law. Experience in leading tax department in a Multinational company and with experience in a Big 4 firm is desired. 10 or more years of progressive experience in tax management, compliance, and planning roles. Strong knowledge of tax regulations, audit processes, and financial reporting standards. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional finance and business teams. Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills related to tax issues and compliance. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic and complex environment. Experience in managing a large team. Solid proficiency in English and Portuguese. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Implement, manage and improve tax compliance strategies adapting to Brazil's dynamic regulatory environment, ensuring alignment with global standards and anticipate regulatory changes. Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of tax calculation and reporting for external and internal compliance requirements such as USGAAP Provision, FIN48, FAS5, Audit reports, cash and ETR tax forecast. Proactive to implement technology and automation solutions. Develop and mentor the local team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, proactive attitude. Champion data-driven decision-making by leveraging analytics to identify compliance trends, optimize tax strategies and manage tax risk effectively. Overseeing all aspects of Brazil Tax Reform, keeping on track with new legal requirement and lead the cross functional team to execute the financial strategy to guarantee Tax Compliance, optimize the future financial impacts and cash flow. title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: A SICPA é uma empresa suíça de tecnologia. Dentro da SICPA, o departamento de Pesquisa e Inovação Digital dimensiona produtos de tecnologia digital de ponta para uso no setor público. A equipe de Ciência de Dados traduz o aprendizado de máquina avançado em recursos robustos e de nível de produção, em parceria com os departamentos de produto e engenharia para fornecer modelos confiáveis, seguros e escaláveis em domínios como mobilização de receita, verificação de identidade, segurança na área da saúde e proteção de marca. Este é um ambiente para engenheiros de ML que valorizam práticas de engenharia rigorosas, impacto mensurável e colaboração com especialistas em ciência de materiais, digital e ciência de dados. Visão geral da função: Estamos procurando um engenheiro de aprendizado de máquina experiente para projetar, desenvolver e implantar modelos avançados de aprendizado de máquina e IA para impulsionar os produtos e soluções da SICPA. Esta função faz a ponte entre a pesquisa em ciência de dados e a engenharia de produção, garantindo que os modelos sejam escaláveis, confiáveis e integrados a aplicações do mundo real. description: This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat position with an attractive relocation package. Please note only qualified candidates will be contacted. *** Candidates with Chemical Engineering degree and 17-25 years of experience in Refinery Only*** ***English proficiency (written and spoken) required. Submit CV in English for consideration*** Overview We are seeking an experienced Process Simulation Twin (PST) and Optimization Engineer to join our Reliability Solutions Department (RSD) within our Global Manufacturing Excellence Center. Global Manufacturing Excellence (GME) is the recognized Center of Excellence driving value across Saudi Aramco’s Downstream Global manufacturing portfolio. Your primary role is to deploy and sustain online process simulations (process digital twins), perform process optimization activities to identify opportunities, monitor process performance KPIs and develop advanced process optimization data-enabled solutions. This role sits at the boundary of process engineering and digitalization beyond traditional process simulation roles. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between rigorous thermodynamic models, process digital twins, real-time process data and hybrid analytics through AI. Key Responsibilities As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following: Lead the development, deployment, and sustainment of PST that integrate real-time process data with rigorous equation-oriented or sequential simulation engines in alignment with corporate objectives. Utilize PST to perform automated monitoring of facility health, detecting deviations between ideal performance and actual plant operations to identify opportunity gaps. Develop and maintain thermodynamic models and mathematical equations that accurately represent the behavior of various processes ensuring the PST accurately reflects the current state of the facility (including heat exchanger fouling, catalyst decay, etc.). Perform offline engineering studies using PST to analyze complex operational problems, debottleneck constraints, and conduct "what-if" scenarios based on current operating conditions. Act as the technical liaison between data teams and Operations/Process Engineering teams, leading technical sessions on model architecture, data quality, and commissioning. Lead process optimization sessions to de-bottleneck key process units such as CDU/VDU, Hydrocrackers, Catalytic crackers, Diesel Hydrotreaters, Isomerization. Benchmark process optimization KPIs with 15+ operating facilities and provide development of programs, processes, guidelines and best practices. Provide subject matter expertise to operating facilities Operations, Maintenance, and Engineering teams by consulting, providing awareness sessions, and participating and leading technical exchanges and conferences. You must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience in Process Simulations, Online Modeling, or Real-Time Optimization (preferably ROMeo). 20 years of experience is preferred. You will be able to Demonstrate expertise in process engineering and flowsheet-based processes simulation. Preferred Equation Oriented simulation. You will have comprehensive understanding of refinery facilities, feedstock/product movements, margins, giveaways, process yields, and mass and energy balances. Demonstrated experience connecting simulations to live data sources (Data Historians, OPC, etc.). Strong understanding of data reconciliation, model tuning, and dealing with gross errors in industrial data is also required. title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description: Gerente de Projeto - Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Neste contexto a AVSI irá operacionalizar um projeto no Municipio do Rio de Janeiro e em algumas áreas da baixada fluminense, com objetivo de mobilização social, organização comunitária e atividades correlatas, visando ao engajamento e a integração das comunidades nos municípios de atuação da empresa que são localizados no estado do Rio de Janeiro, com predominância nas regiões metropolitanas e capital. O foco está na sensibilização sobre as atividades sociais da empresa através de momentos educativos, alinhando transparência, inclusão e bem-estar da população atendida. Poderão ser promovidos eventos, com objetivo de ativar outros parceiros, para consolidar a relação de confiança entre a empresa e a população local, criando marketing positivo e desenvolvimento das comunidades. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Gerente de Projeto será responsável pela gestão integral do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento das diretrizes contratuais e dos procedimentos da AVSI. Essa função abrange a coordenação completa do ciclo do projeto, integrando aspectos gerenciais e administrativos, com responsabilidade final pelo planejamento e execução das atividades, gerenciamento da equipe dedicada, mobilização das comunidades, suporte técnico e administrativo, além do desenvolvimento de metodologias de controle e logística para assegurar a execução eficiente e os resultados esperados. Gerenciar o orçamento do programa, assegurando o uso eficiente dos recursos financeiros, acompanhando a execução orçamentária, controlando despesas, e garantindo o cumprimento das regras e diretrizes estabelecidas pelo contrato e pelos procedimentos da AVSI. Organizar as atividades do projeto nos seus aspectos operacionais e administrativos, apresentando relatórios ao responsável preposto. Auxiliar na solicitação de compras previstas no Plano de Aquisição aprovado, garantindo a correta descrição de bens e serviços para o setor de aquisições. Selecionar, coordenar, supervisionar, monitorar e avaliar a equipe técnica do programa. Aplicar rigorosamente os procedimentos e regras estabelecidos nos manuais da AVSI. Manter atualizado o arquivo de documentos no sistema de PATRIMONIALIZAÇÃO da AVSI. Enviar periodicamente ao setor de Comunicação materiais sobre o projeto para publicação. Contribuir para a elaboração de documentos descritivos necessários à prestação de contas do projeto. Representar a AVSI no diálogo e na relação técnica com a equipe da contratante. Realizar missões e atividades em outros territórios ou escritórios da AVSI no Brasil, quando necessário. Contribuir para a elaboração de relatórios internos destinados ao cliente. Participar de reuniões e conferências periódicas, sempre que solicitado. Desenvolver o programa de acordo com as especificações técnicas do contrato, respeitando prazos, escopo e conteúdos previamente estabelecidos. Executar os processos necessários para a plena realização das atividades previstas no programa. Gerenciar a execução técnica das atividades, assegurando que os conteúdos, metodologias, estruturas e equipamentos sejam aplicados de maneira favorável ao alcance dos objetivos propostos. Coordenar a mobilização e promover o diálogo para engajamento do público-alvo. Articular parcerias com outras organizações para fortalecer ações do programa. Organizar a logística de campo, elaborando documentos comprobatórios que evidenciem o desenvolvimento das atividades realizadas. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internas. Requisitos Escolaridade Graduação Habilidade Técnica Desejável residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ - Avançado Conhecimento avançado no Pacote Office, em especial Excel - Avançado Desejável CNH B e habilidade na direção de veículos. - Avançado Possuir experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos em comunidade de baixa renda; - Avançado Possuir vivência na coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares; - Avançado Desejável atuação pregressa de trabalho no Setor Privado ou em parceria; - Avançado Ensino Superior em Comunicação Social, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, ou áreas afins. - Avançado Possuir experiência em planejamento e execução de projetos com foco em logística, operação e mobilização social; - Avançado Benefícios Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Seguro de vida Vale alimentação Vale refeição Localização Rua do Carmo, Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, Brasil, #J-18808-Ljbffr

Qualifications +5 years relevant OHS/HSE practical experience, with preference within an international company. National/international certificate/diploma in HSE/OHS. Interested in working in a mechanical environment, supporting safety culture development in the workshop and customer’s site (Marine, O&G and power generation industry). Good understanding of mechanical service processes and ability in identification of risk. Benefits Pharmacy Allowance. Credit Union. Global Fitness Platform (Wellhub). Profit Sharing. Private Pension Plan. Health Plan. Dental Plan. Life Insurance. Transport Voucher. Food Voucher. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Captain
description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Here Is What We Offer Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture Join Howard University and thrive with us! Basic Function The purpose of this position is to assist in the management of the Department of Public Safety (DPS) by providing administrative oversight and assisting in policy development. It may be designated Shift Commander and provide supervision and coordination over the daily operations of assigned personnel in keeping with established goals and objectives of the Department of Public Safety serving the Howard University and Howard University Hospital (HUH). SUPERVISORY Acts in a senior management capacity over other positions; orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. Accountability Internal contacts include academic and medical executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the University and Hospital. External contacts include parent/guardians, patients, Mayoral Command Post, representatives from local and national Homeland security operations, social service agencies, special police officers, Security Officer’s Management Branch, members of the local criminal justice system to include Metropolitan Police, U.S. Attorney’s Office, Department of Corrections, Youth Services organizations, etc. and the general public. Principal Accountabilities Serves as a Commander over a large section or Division of the Howard University/HUH Department of Public Safety Operation; responsible for all operations in assigned sector on a 24 hour per day basis; administers comprehensive security programs to prevent crimes against persons and property on University Campus and HUH. Provides supervision and oversight over the duties of Deputy Shift Commander in shift operations to ensure that duties involving training and overseeing patrol activities, e.g. directing traffic, controlling crowds; securing facilities are conducted successfully. Works with higher management to develop procedures and directives, rules and regulations for the effective operations of the Department of Public Safety Police force within the guidelines of University, HUH, Federal and Municipal Governments’ laws and statutes. Prepares high level administrative reports, provides statistical data, reviews all incident reports; advises HUH and University management on security issues. Makes comprehensive plans to coordinate special events with the DC Office of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security or other federal or municipal agency; takes appropriate actions in response to unforeseen or unexpected incidents; ensures compliance with applicable policy, laws, rules and regulations; maintains emergency plans and makes determination as to when plans should be employed. May manage and coordinate plans and set priorities for fiscal activities of entire Department of Public Safety or may supervise and assist in the preparation of the annual budget for assigned sector; submits recommendations to management for review; may participate in the selection and evaluation process of new employees. Assists in establishing performance metrics consistent with the duties and responsibilities for the Department of Public Safety and HUH. Periodically inspects departments, facilities, equipment and personnel to ensure their safety and compliance with Department of Public Safety policies and procedures. Makes long term projection for labor distribution to ensure that critical areas are covered; provides instruction to immediate subordinates in the proper performance of their duties. May coordinate the acquisition and maintenance of Police equipment; direct the issuance of equipment and ensures accountability for equipment materials and supplies including automobiles, communication equipment, uniforms etc. May confer with management, to review achievements and discuss changes in long and short range goals and objectives; may monitor and plan the training schedule for in-house and outside agencies; maintain expiration roster and prepares license renewal for officers. Responds in person to the most serious incidents when called by subordinates to incidents occurring on University or HUH property; establishes a Field Command Post to supervise and direct police activities; meets with outside law enforcement and regulatory agencies. Assists the Chief and Deputy Chief with various policy, fiscal, budgetary, human resources and other administrative matters as required. May serve in the absence of the Deputy Chief as required. Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Chief of the Department of Public Safety or other relevant authority. Core Competencies Extensive knowledge of criminal law, including elements of offenses, rules of evidence, laws of arrest, search and seizures, methods of law enforcement, maintenance of public safety and security, and related law enforcement principles. Extensive knowledge of current departmental, municipal and governmental policies and procedural changes relating to security. Ability to demonstrate expertise in hospital safety and security principles and practices in order to effectively assist in the directing of the Hospital’s safety and security programs and activities. Ability to maintain and provide a general source of University, Hospital and community information. General knowledge of computer programs, to include word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation software. Enhanced skills in the use of firearms and other standard police equipment with the ability to secure a Special Police Officer Commission with firearm authorization from the District of Columbia. Enhanced skills in the use of both oral and written English with the ability to read technical literature, write investigative reports and to express complex cases and relationships orally and written forms. Excellent skill in public and customer relations with the ability to use tact, diplomacy and decorum. Ability to make public presentations, to negotiate and to successfully navigate internal and external politics. Ability to direct others in the investigative process and to provide leadership, training and direction to subordinates. Ability to remain emotionally stable and to display mature judgment and tact in explosive and/or dangerous situations. Ability to work a flexible schedule and be on call during a 24 hour a day, seven days per week timeframe. Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with staff, students, university officials, faculty, other public safety organizations; and the general public. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Law Enforcement, Criminal Justice or closely related field and four (4) years of work experience which included three (3) years at a supervisory level or the equivalent combination of eight (8) years combined relevant training and experience. Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Expected Pay Range: $80,000 to $85,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Social Media Manager
description: Social Media Manager Department: Administration Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Senior Social Media Manager (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Social Media Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Digital Marketing team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for managing, planning and delivering social media campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Develop and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with tournament goals and target audiences based on country and consumer audience. Set specific objectives for social media campaigns, such as increasing brand awareness, driving traffic, and boosting engagement through a fan-first approach. Ensure all social media content aligns with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging guidelines. Create, curate, and publish engaging and relevant content across social platforms, including text, images, videos, and other multimedia. Develop content calendars and schedule posts across platforms including Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and more. Monitor social media platforms for trends, mentions, and relevant conversations. Use social listening tools to gather insights and trends for stakeholders across marketing, creative, and digital content teams. Track and analyse social media performance using tools such as Google Analytics, Sprinklr, native platform analytics, and third-party tools. Prepare and present reports on engagement, reach, follower growth, and ROI, using insights to optimise strategies. Promote a continuously improving culture of safety, with open reporting of safety deficiencies, human factor issues and compliance with local laws to uphold the delivery of safe and secure operations. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Auxiliar o nutricionista nas atividades de gerenciamento da unidade e orientar funcionários no preparo e distribuição de alimentos. Nesta posição, você irá desenvolver atividades focadas na otimização de processos de recebimento e redução de inadimplência por meio de melhorias operacionais através de automação de processos, rotinas e dados, garantindo conformidade fiscal, contábil e mantendo um relacionamento de qualidade com os clientes. O que você fará: Crédito e Cobrança: Desenvolver e garantir a execução eficiente de atividades diárias de faturamento, cobrança, conciliação e relatórios analíticos; Controle de Inadimplência: Executar de forma eficiente as estratégias de recuperação de crédito, desenvolver e monitorar indicadores de inadimplência (DSO, taxa de recebimento) e implementar ações corretivas para redução de atrasos; Automação de Processos e Otimização: Identificar oportunidades de automação de rotinas utilizando RPA e IA, otimizando fluxos de trabalho para ganhos de produtividade e redução de custos operacionais; Análise de Dados e Relatórios Executivos: Elaborar análises financeiras, dashboards e relatórios executivos, fornecendo insights sobre a carteira de recebíveis e previsões de inadimplência para a tomada de decisão estratégica; Relacionamento com Clientes: Manter comunicação proativa e empática com clientes, negociar prazos de pagamento, resolver conflitos e discrepâncias, e implementar estratégias de satisfação com foco em relacionamento de longo prazo e confiança; Proatividade e Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos operacionais, propor soluções inovadoras e implementar melhorias que agreguem valor ao negócio e melhorem a experiência do cliente. Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. O que você precisa ter: Formação: Graduação completa em Contabilidade, Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins; Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 3 anos de experiência comprovada em Contas a Receber, com conhecimento profundo de processos de cobrança e redução de inadimplência. Competências Técnicas: Excel Avançado; Inglês Avançado; Power BI ou ferramentas similares de visualização de dados e dashboards; Conhecimento de automação com RPA e IA para otimização de processos; Competências Comportamentais: Proativo e Hands‑on: Capacidade de execução eficiente; Comunicação Clara: Habilidade de apresentar dados de forma clara e objetiva; Orientação a Resultados: Foco em eficiência, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e redução de inadimplência; Empatia e Relacionamento: Capacidade de negociar com clientes e devedores de forma ética e eficaz. Será um diferencial se você tiver: Experiência em instituições educacionais ou grupos multinacionais; Experiência com Oracle JD Edwards ERP; Conhecimento de legislação tributária brasileira (NF‑e, LGPD, conformidade fiscal); Experiência em projetos de transformação digital e otimização de processos. DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA: O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem‑estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperará o mesmo de você, assim como que você se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem‑estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Fiscalização Técnica em Obras em Campo - Presencial
description: Fiscalização Técnica em Obras em Campo - Presencial Join to apply for the Fiscalização Técnica em Obras em Campo - Presencial role at Accenture Brasil Um time que faz parte da mudança Abraçamos o poder da mudança para criar valor e sucesso compartilhado para nossos clientes, funcionários, acionistas, parceiros e comunidades. Contamos com a maior rede mundial de centros de tecnologia avançada e operações inteligentes. Provocamos a mudança no mercado trabalhando juntos mundo afora para fazer um mundo de diferenças. A Accenture é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais líder em soluções para digital, nuvem e segurança. Ao combinar experiência incomparável e habilidades especializadas em mais de 40 setores, oferecemos serviços em Estratégia e Consultoria, Tecnologia, Operações, Industry X e a Accenture Song. Ao trabalharmos juntos, a mudança se torna a fonte de progresso mais dinâmica e poderosa que você tem. Somos mais de 738 mil pessoas, presentes em mais de 120 países, engajados em fazer inovação todos os dias e transformar o mundo em um lugar melhor para as pessoas. Usando o poder dos dados e do digital, ajudamos nossos clientes a reimaginar os produtos que fabricam e como os fabricam. Agora é um momento emocionante para trabalhar em engenharia e manufatura digital. Buscamos talentos para ajudar nossos clientes a se transformarem - combinando os poderosos recursos digitais da Accenture com profunda experiência em engenharia e fabricação. Estar aqui é trabalhar em projetos inovadores de engenharia e manufatura para obter maior produtividade, impulsionar o crescimento e alcançar seus compromissos de sustentabilidade, rodeado com tecnologias de ponta, como AR/VR, nuvem, IA, 5G, robótica e gêmeos digitais para transformar a forma como os produtos são projetados e fabricados. Conhecimentos necessários: Gestão de Projetos de Capita – domínio avançado dos processos de planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento de obras de grande porte. Formação superior ou cursando em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura ou área correlata. Experiência em atividades técnicas relacionadas a obras, fiscalização ou gestão de contratos de engenharia. Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias aplicáveis (ABNT, NRs, licenciamento ambiental, entre outras). Capacidade de elaborar relatórios técnicos, pareceres e medições com rigor técnico e clareza comunicacional. O que você vai fazer no seu dia a dia: Realizar inspeções de rotina e especializadas em obras e projetos de engenharia, abrangendo disciplinas civil, estrutural e instalações (MEP). Verificar se as etapas executadas estão em conformidade com os projetos aprovados, especificações técnicas e condições de licenças. Identificar e registrar não conformidades ou desvios de execução, apoiar o rastreamento das correções e elaborar relatórios de campo. Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia, construção e segurança para garantir a execução segura, eficiente e em conformidade com as normas e legislações aplicáveis. Participar ativamente de discussões técnicas, propondo soluções e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de capacidades em gestão de projetos de capital. O profissional estará presencialmente na localidade onde a obra está ocorrendo. Além disso, é desejável conhecimento: Gestão de Riscos Garantia da Qualidade Relacionamento com Stakeholders Gestão Orçamentária Conformidade Regulatória Benefícios: Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Vale Refeição ou Alimentação Conforme política vigente Localidade da vaga: Brasil #J-18808-Ljbffr

Utilizar a ferramenta Veeva nas promoções dos produtos aos médicos e garantir que sejam concluídas todas as pesquisas de segmentação propostas pela empresa. Participar de Congressos e eventos médicos cadastrando médicos, promovendo os medicamentos de seu segmento. Compartilhar informações de inteligência de mercado com todo o time In Field. Apresentar Planos de Ação para reversão ou incremento de resultados. Analisar mensalmente relatórios fornecidos pela empresa (DATASUS, MDTR, REP&DM, HUMANIZAR, etc.) realizando interface com o Gerente Distrital sobre os KPIs atingidos e respectivos planos de ação. Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado através do conhecimento amplo do Transaccional Journey. Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial e Compliance da empresa. Comunicar quaisquer relatos de eventos adversos à Farmacovigilância dentro do prazo de 24 horas estabelecido pela empresa. Concluir 100% de todos os treinamentos online estabelecidos pela empresa. Conduzir as ações e decisões sob responsabilidade do cargo respeitando o Código de Conduta Comercial da empresa. Qualificações ESCOLARIDADE: Superior completo preferencialmente em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Farmácia, e demais áreas afins. Inglês intermediário. EXPERIÊNCIA: Experiência prévia no mercado farmacêutico. Experiência em demanda médica na especialidade de imunologia/gastro. Disponibilidade para viagens em 65% do tempo. Atuação principal na sede do Rio de Janeiro, mas também irá atender os estados PE, AL, PB e RN. Informações adicionais CONHECIMENTOS: Mercado farmacêutico e de saúde. Pacote Office. Visão estratégica do negócio. Atuação em ambiente matricial. COMPORTAMENTOS ESPERADOS: Sucesso comprovado em vendas e consistentes habilidades de apresentação. Oferece ideias e soluções inovadoras para maximizar oportunidades de negócios e enfrentar os desafios. Contribui de forma impactante para o negócio fornecendo ideias relevantes e aplicáveis, antecipando-se e respondendo com agilidade. Constrói parcerias colaborativas com pares, colegas de outros distritos e equipe matricial, etc. Apoia a equipe na identificação, interna e externa, de informações e oportunidades de aprendizados. Demonstra os comportamentos esperados na AbbVie de acordo com os elementos de cultura e os atributos de liderança – Ways We Work. A AbbVie está comprometida em agir honestamente, promover a inovação, mudar vidas, servir nossa comunidade e promover diversidade e inclusão. Emprega os profissionais mais qualificados sem discriminação dos candidatos com base em raça, cor, religião, nacionalidade, idade, sexo (incluindo gravidez), deficiências físicas ou mentais, doenças, informações genéticas, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil ou qualquer outro status protegido por lei. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Online teachers for IAS Economics
description: Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part-time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally. Job Summary Join our global team as an online teacher for IAS Economics (Cambridge Curricula) and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student’s unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you’ll deliver AS‑Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students’ educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching. Must be available to teach in the Australian timezone, between the hours of 11:15 am – 1:00 pm AEST. Key Responsibilities Deliver personalized, high‑quality instruction in a one‑on‑one virtual setting, adapting to each student’s unique learning needs. Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment. Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes. Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines. Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience. Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth. Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library. Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access. Required Qualifications A minimum of 5 years of teaching Level/Form 7‑13 experience in a school setting. Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching. Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods. Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations. Preferred Qualifications Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license. Online teaching experience. About Crimson Global Academy CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students’ limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures. We are doing this by: Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age. Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter: Experiência de até 2 anos em Segurança da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Software, Infraestrutura ou áreas correlatas; Conhecimento básico sobre desenvolvimento seguro e vulnerabilidades de aplicações; Conhecimento dos conceitos do OWASP Top 10 e fundamentos de segurança de aplicações; Noções de análise de código-fonte em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Java, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares); Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código como Git; Conhecimento básico de pipelines CI/CD e conceitos de DevOps; Capacidade de aprender rapidamente novas tecnologias e ferramentas; Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe. Será bacana se você também tiver: Experiência acadêmica, estágio ou projetos pessoais relacionados à segurança de aplicações. Conhecimento básico em ferramentas de SAST, DAST ou SCA, como Checkmarx, Fortify, SonarQube, Veracode ou Snyk; Conhecimento básico em APIs REST e conceitos de segurança de APIs; Noções de Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP); Conhecimento básico em containers (Docker) e Kubernetes; Conhecimento em Python, PowerShell ou Shell Script para automação; Inglês avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação. Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial). Review and guide work from design contractors, consultants, and agency partners to maintain visual and strategic alignment. Strong proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and motion/video tools like After Effects or Premiere. Experience designing for web and mobile platforms, with a basic understanding of HTML/CSS and responsive design principles. Knowledge of UX/UI principles and experience collaborating on interactive or data‑driven products. Comfort managing brand systems and working with design partners or vendors. Excellent visual communication skills with a passion for turning complex ideas into clear, accessible visuals. Commitment to social justice, equity, and human rights. Travel Travel is required. Employer‑paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required). Exceptional retirement savings plan (non‑contributory for employees) and life insurance. Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more. A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact. Description of the Organization Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time‑limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems. Guided by our founder’s values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take. Open Society Foundations is committed to advancing diversity, equity and inclusion, and to building a diverse staff that reflects the movements, issues and communities that our mission serves. title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Brownfield Offshore Coordinator
description: We are looking for our next Offshore Coordinator for Brownfield projects. Do you thrive in an offshore environment and enjoy coordinating complex activities involving multiple stakeholders? Are you someone who combines technical knowledge, strong planning skills, and a hands‑on approach to project execution? As we continue to strengthen our Brownfield project delivery capabilities, we are looking for a new colleague to join our team and support the successful execution of modifications, campaigns and operational projects across our FPSO fleet. In this role, you will act as a key interface between offshore operations and the project organization, ensuring that planned activities are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with project objectives. You will play an important role throughout the project lifecycle, from preparation and mobilization through execution and close‑out, supporting coordination between offshore teams, contractors, vendors, and onshore stakeholders. You will contribute to maintaining high standards of HSE, quality and operational performance while helping to ensure that project activities are delivered in line with technical requirements, schedules, and regulatory expectations. The position requires a proactive mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage priorities in a dynamic operational environment. We are looking for a candidate who is self‑driven, collaborative, and solution‑oriented, with solid offshore experience and a strong technical background. You should be comfortable working across disciplines, engaging with both operational and project teams, and taking ownership of activities from planning through execution. Responsibilities Ensure awareness of our HSE, Quality policy and business ethical standards are established and maintained throughout projects. Lead the projects and tasks related with Operations team offshore. Project Planning : develop the scope and execution schedule supporting the vendors surveyors, offshore leadership, and project engineer. Support onshore organization regarding vendor and equipment verification; site visits, manpower qualifications and FATs. Acquisition : support on material identification/specification and start procurement process (raise MRs). Project Preparation : prepare work‑packs for execution, materials identification, and related activities; provide quality assurance for efficient execution. Project Execution : responsible for third parties’ activities in the installation; act as liaison toward crew and onboard management; monitor progress and inspect HSEQ working practices; issue execution daily reports. Project Close‑out : ensure proper completion, material demobilization and project close‑out. Risk Management : identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to reduce project impacts. Documentation : prepare and organize technical project documentation. Communication : assist the Project Engineer as the link with the Offshore crew; lead meetings to provide transparent information; prepare and issue reports. Ensure that the design and construction of equipment & facilities as well as the project execution are compliant with the client’s specification, functional requirements, and regulatory requirements. Qualifications Background / Qualifications: Technicians/Engineers with technical background. Offshore experience is mandatory (minimum 3 years). Knowledge of technical drawings and equipment datasheets. Hard Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Project and Primavera is an advantage. Proficiency in English (reading, writing and conversation). Ability to read, analyse and interpret technical procedures in both Portuguese and English. Soft Skills: Structured, analytical and solution oriented. Team player who can work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks. Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and unforeseen events. Proactive, with a strong sense of initiative and accountability. Strong coordination and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and collaborate with offshore and onshore teams, contractors and vendors. Leadership skills and the ability to work effectively within a multi‑disciplinary environment. Benefits We live by our #TEAM values – they always guide our actions, no compromises. People who are committed to excellence, developing their professional experience as they deliver organizational outcomes. Development opportunities where you may be part of internationally based project teams and collaborate with colleagues across our global organization. An open and collaborative workplace where you can have an immediate impact and contribute to the success of our operations. Challenging work in a dynamic offshore and project environment with exposure to a wide range of technical disciplines and stakeholders. A competitive total compensation package including health benefits, pension, incentive programmes and other local benefits. The opportunity to work alongside highly experienced professionals within one of the world’s leading offshore energy infrastructure companies. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Lead the projects and tasks related with Operations team offshore. Support onshore organization regarding vendor and equipment verification, site visits, manpower qualifications and FATs. Acquisition: support on material identification/specification and start procurement process (raise MRs). Project Execution: responsible for third parties’ activities in the installation; be a liaison towards crew and onboard management, monitor progress and inspect HSEQ working practices, issue execution daily reports. Project Close‑out: ensure proper completion, material demobilization and project close‑out. Risk Management: identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to reduce project impacts. Documentation: prepare and organize technical project documentation. Communication: assist the Project Engineer being the link with the Offshore crew, lead meetings to provide transparent information, prepare and issue reports. Ensure that the design and construction of equipment & facilities as well as the project execution are compliant with the client’s specification, functional requirements and regulatory requirements. Knowledge of technical drawings and equipment datasheets. Hard Skills Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of Project and Primavera is an advantage. Proficiency in English (reading, writing and conversation). Ability to read, analyse and interpret technical procedures in both Portuguese and English. Soft Skills Structured, analytical and solution oriented. Team player who can also work independently and take ownership of assigned tasks. Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities and unforeseen events. Proactive, with a strong sense of initiative and accountability. Strong coordination and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with offshore and onshore teams, contractors and vendors. Leadership skills and the ability to work effectively within a multi‑disciplinary environment. What We Offer We live by our #TEAM values – they always guide our actions, no compromises. People who are committed to excellence, developing their professional experience as they deliver organizational outcomes. Development opportunities where you may be part of internationally based project teams and collaborate with colleagues across our global organization. An open and collaborative workplace where you can have an immediate impact and contribute to the success of our operations. Challenging work in a dynamic offshore and project environment with exposure to a wide range of technical disciplines and stakeholders. A competitive total compensation package including health benefits, pension, incentive programmes and other local benefits. Skill in maintaining records and recording test results. Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with patients, medical staff, and the public. Ability to be detail-oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver quality customer service. Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions, and behave with tact, decorum, and diplomacy. Ability to maintain quality control standards. title: Brazil - Remote: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The Opportunity We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges: Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency. Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems. Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets. What You’ll Do You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks: Core Responsibilities High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models. System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems. Rapid Delivery: Adopt a ‘deliver fast’ mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards. Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more): Streaming & High-Throughput Data Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time. Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings. GenAI & Autonomous Agents Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating. Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers Graph & Knowledge Engineering Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data. Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal. The Technology Stack We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track. Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes. Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data. title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Brazil, Belo Horizonte; Brazil, Campinas; Brazil, Rio[...]
description: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About the Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows.
